name: rbenv

patches.old:
git init
    git remote add -f -t master origin https://github.com/rbenv/rbenv.git
    git checkout -b master origin/master

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum
locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke: export PATH="$RBENV_ROOT/bin:$PATH"; mkdir -p "$HOME/rbenv-project"; cd "$HOME/rbenv-project"; rbenv local --unset; rbenv init - bash > "$HOME/rbenv-init"; grep -q RBENV_SHELL "$HOME/rbenv-init"; rbenv rehash; test -d "$RBENV_ROOT/shims"
notes: Manager and ruby-build plugin only, no Ruby runtimes. Preserves official install/init workflow while redirecting git source transport to pinned archives and replacing hardcoded ~/.rbenv with RBENV_ROOT.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
